1.8 For this reason, the constructing of Ritual and Music by the former kings [was a matter of] making regulation for the people. The coarse hemp of mourning garments, crying and weeping -- these are what was used to regulate the mourning rites. Bells and drums, shields and axes -- these are what was used to harmonize peace and happiness. Marriages, caps and hairpins -- these are what was used to distinguish males and females. Archery contests and celebrations, banquet entertainments -- these are what was used to engage in proper social intercourse. Ritual regulates the people's hearts; Music harmonizes the people's voices. Administration is used to carry them out; Punishment is used to prevent [transgressions against] them. If the four develop and go unopposed, then the kingly Way is complete.

2.2 Music comes out from within, Ritual comes into being from without. Music comes out from within, thus it is still. Ritual comes into being from without, thus it is ordered. Great Music must be marked by ease, Great Ritual must be marked by simplicity.90 If Music reaches the ultimate, there are no grievances. If Ritual reaches the ultimate, [the people] do not struggle [with one another]. The governance of all under Heaven through deference is what is meant by Ritual and Music. Rebellious people do not arise, the feudal lords submit like guests, weaponry and armour are not employed, and the five punishments are not made use of. The masses are without suffering, and the Son of Heaven is not angry. -- If it is like this, then Music has reached its goal. Uniting the affections of father and son, making manifest the order of the old and the young, so as to gain respect for the Son of Heaven throughout the land -- if it is like this, then Ritual has been carried out.

In this way, then, throughout the land [the people] are combined in respect and united in love. Ritual is that which combines respect through different affairs. Music is that which unites love through different patterns. The natures (qing) of Ritual and Music are united, thus enlightened kings follow each other in them. Thus affairs go along with the times, and names go together with accomplishments.
